newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldiers hit Palestinian woman.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers hit Palestinian woman.

text.p: A Palestinian woman said on Monday that Israeli soldiers had hit and bruised her when she refused to evacuate her West Bank house which had been marked for demolition.

"We received a notice from the Israeli army to evacuate our home and we ignored it. Israeli soldiers came today to demolish our homes and we tried to prevent them and they hit me," said Khadra Al-Hlees.
Al-Hlees, who was bruised on her body, said the Israeli army had demolished five homes in the village of Fasayel. The Israeli army said it was examining the report.
Fasayel, north of Palestinian self-ruled Jericho, remains under Israeli military control.

The PLO set up autonomous enclaves in parts of the Gaza Strip and West Bank under interim deal with Israel signed in 1993. More than 130,000 Jews live among nearly two million Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.
